name: Argentiferous-Dirge
description: From orbit the planet is a painted oval, serene; up close it is violence given volume. Hurricane cells wider than moons chase each other along the shear lines, and the lightning never quite stops.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless.
automated beacon of unknown purpose was established during the last boom and never decommissioned. Its roster lists eleven souls; life-support draws power for thirty.
There is money in antimatter traces and exotic matter and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
